title: Communion of Saints
definition: The communion of saints is the shared fellowship, care, worship, and spiritual life believers have together in Christ.
summary: Believers are united not only individually to Christ but also to one another. They share burdens, encouragement, gifts, and hope.
christFocus: Christ unites His people into fellowship through His saving work and the Spirit's presence.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Believers are united not only individually to Christ but also to one another. They share burdens, encouragement, gifts, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
